risk_templates.title: Undersized conductors for design current
risk_templates.description: Cable cross-section not sized for design current considering installation method, ambient temperature and grouping factors. Can lead to overheating and insulation damage.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Verify design current per circuit; size conductors to local wiring rules using recognized tables or approved calculation tools. Document assumptions and correction factors.
risk_templates.title_en: Undersized conductors for design current
risk_templates.title_is: Of litlar leiðar miðað við hönnunarstraum
risk_templates.description_en: Cable cross-section not sized for design current considering installation method, ambient temperature and grouping factors. Can lead to overheating and insulation damage.
risk_templates.description_is: Þverskurður leiða er ekki valinn fyrir hönnunarstraum með tilliti til lagningar, umhverfishita og hópunar. Getur valdið ofhitnun og skemmdum á einangrun.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Verify design current per circuit; size conductors to local wiring rules using recognized tables or approved calculation tools. Document assumptions and correction factors.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Staðfesta hönnunarstraum hverrar rásar; velja leiðar samkvæmt staðlum með viðurkenndum töflum eða reikniforritum. Skrá forsendur og leiðréttingarstuðla.

risk_templates.title: Insufficient short-circuit withstand of protective devices
risk_templates.description: Breaking capacity (kA) of protective devices is below the prospective fault current at their point of installation.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Calculate or obtain prospective short-circuit current from DSO. Select devices with adequate breaking capacity for the installation location, including selectivity where required.
risk_templates.title_en: Insufficient short-circuit withstand of protective devices
risk_templates.description_en: Breaking capacity (kA) of protective devices is below the prospective fault current at their point of installation.
risk_templates.description_is: Brotthol (kA) verndartækja er undir fyrirséðum stutningstraum á uppsetningarstað.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Calculate or obtain prospective short-circuit current from DSO. Select devices with adequate breaking capacity for the installation location, including selectivity where required.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Reikna eða fá fyrirséðan stutningstraum frá dreifiveitu. Velja tæki með nægjanlegri brottholsfærni, þ.m.t. valkvæmni þar sem krafist er.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate earthing and bonding
risk_templates.description: Protective conductors and bonding not designed to provide a reliable fault path, resulting in dangerous touch voltages or delayed disconnection.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Design earthing system according to supply characteristics and local standards. Verify conductor sizes and routing; specify continuity testing and earth fault loop impedance checks.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate earthing and bonding
risk_templates.description_en: Protective conductors and bonding not designed to provide a reliable fault path, resulting in dangerous touch voltages or delayed disconnection.
risk_templates.description_is: Verndarleiðar og jafnspennutengingar eru ekki hannaðar til að tryggja örugga bilunaleið, sem getur valdið hættulegum snertispennu eða seinfærðri aftengingu.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Design earthing system according to supply characteristics and local standards. Verify conductor sizes and routing; specify continuity testing and earth fault loop impedance checks.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Hanna jarðkerfi eftir birgðu og staðlum. Staðfesta stærðir og leiðir; krefjast samfelldisprófa og mælinga á spennu við jarðbilun.

risk_templates.title: Work on or near live parts
risk_templates.description: Unintended contact with live conductors during installation, testing or fault finding, leading to electric shock or arc flash.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Apply safe isolation procedures with written steps (lockout/tagout). Prohibit live working unless justified and controlled. Use insulated tools and appropriate PPE.
risk_templates.title_en: Work on or near live parts
risk_templates.title_is: Vinna á eða nálægt spennuðum hlutum
risk_templates.description_en: Unintended contact with live conductors during installation, testing or fault finding, leading to electric shock or arc flash.
risk_templates.description_is: Óviljandi snerting við spennuðar leiðar við uppsetningu, prófanir eða bilaleit, með hættu á rafmagnsstinglum eða bogaflæði.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Apply safe isolation procedures with written steps (lockout/tagout). Prohibit live working unless justified and controlled. Use insulated tools and appropriate PPE.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Beita öruggri aðskilnaðarferli með skriflegum skrefum (lásun/merking). Banna spennuvinnu nema hún sé réttlætt og stýrð. Nota einangrað verkfæri og viðeigandi vörn.

risk_templates.title: Cable damage from sharp edges or supports
risk_templates.description: Cables routed over sharp edges, tight bends or unsupported spans leading to sheath damage and eventual faults.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Use proper cable management (grommets, saddles, trays). Respect minimum bending radii and fixing distances. Inspect mechanical protection before energizing.
risk_templates.title_en: Cable damage from sharp edges or supports
risk_templates.title_is: Skemmdir á kapli vegna skarpra brúna eða festinga
risk_templates.description_en: Cables routed over sharp edges, tight bends or unsupported spans leading to sheath damage and eventual faults.
risk_templates.description_is: Kaplar lagðir yfir skarpa brún, of þétt beygðir eða án nægilegrar stuðningss, sem getur valdið skemmdum á skauti og síðar bilunum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Use proper cable management (grommets, saddles, trays). Respect minimum bending radii and fixing distances. Inspect mechanical protection before energizing.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Nota viðeigandi kaplahald (grommet, söðla, bretti). Virða lágmarks beygjur og festingarfjarlægðir. Skoða vélfraðlega vernd fyrir spenntingu.

risk_templates.title: Unsealed penetrations compromising fire compartments
risk_templates.description: Cable or conduit penetrations not sealed with approved fire-stopping materials, undermining fire-resistance rating of walls or floors.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Record all penetrations; apply tested fire-stopping systems compatible with substrate and service type. Maintain documentation and as-built drawings.
risk_templates.title_en: Unsealed penetrations compromising fire compartments
risk_templates.description_en: Cable or conduit penetrations not sealed with approved fire-stopping materials, undermining fire-resistance rating of walls or floors.
risk_templates.description_is: Göt eftir kapla eða rör eru ekki þétt með samþykktum eldivarnarefnum, sem skerðir eldþol veggja eða gólf.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Record all penetrations; apply tested fire-stopping systems compatible with substrate and service type. Maintain documentation and as-built drawings.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Skrá öll göt; nota prófuð eldivarnakerfi sem henta undirlagi og þjónustu. Halda skjölum og lokunarupplýsingum við.

risk_templates.title: Safety devices not functionally tested
risk_templates.description: RCDs, AFDDs, emergency stops, fire interfaces or safety circuits not functionally tested before handover.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Prepare commissioning plan including functional tests for all safety-related devices. Record test results and corrective actions in commissioning report.
risk_templates.title_en: Safety devices not functionally tested
risk_templates.description_en: RCDs, AFDDs, emergency stops, fire interfaces or safety circuits not functionally tested before handover.
risk_templates.description_is: Lekastraumsrofar (RCD), AFDD, neyðarstopp, tengingar við brunakerfi eða aðrir öryggisrásir hafa ekki verið prófaðar í raunverulegri virkni áður en verki er skilað.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Prepare commissioning plan including functional tests for all safety-related devices. Record test results and corrective actions in commissioning report.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Gera ræsiplan fyrir afl- og stýrikassa þar sem öllum öryggistengdum búnaði er prófað í virkni. Skrá niðurstöður prófana og allar lagfæringar í verklokaskýrslu.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate circuit and panel labelling
risk_templates.description: Boards, breakers and circuits not clearly labelled, leading to operational errors and unsafe isolation.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Apply durable labels matching as-built documentation and schedules. Include source, destination and circuit designation. Verify labels during final inspection.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate circuit and panel labelling
risk_templates.title_is: Ófullnægjandi merkingar á rásum og tækjakössum
risk_templates.description_en: Boards, breakers and circuits not clearly labelled, leading to operational errors and unsafe isolation.
risk_templates.description_is: Tækjakassar, rofar og rásir eru ekki skýrar merktar, sem getur valdið rekstrarvillum og óöruggum aðskilnaði.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Apply durable labels matching as-built documentation and schedules. Include source, destination and circuit designation. Verify labels during final inspection.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Setja endingargóðar merkingar samkvæmt lokunarupplýsingum og töflum. Innifela uppruna, áfangastað og rásarheiti. Staðfesta við lokaeftirlit.

risk_templates.title: Overloaded final circuits due to changes in use
risk_templates.description: Existing circuits become overloaded when additional loads are connected without review, leading to nuisance tripping or overheating.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Establish change-management procedure for adding loads. Periodically review loading of main panels and key circuits, especially for heating and EV charging.
risk_templates.title_en: Overloaded final circuits due to changes in use
risk_templates.title_is: Álagning á endarás vegna breyttrar notkunar
risk_templates.description_en: Existing circuits become overloaded when additional loads are connected without review, leading to nuisance tripping or overheating.
risk_templates.description_is: Núverandi rásir verða ofhlaðnar þegar álag er bætt við án endurskoðunar, með hættu á óþægilegri rofun eða ofhitnun.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Establish change-management procedure for adding loads. Periodically review loading of main panels and key circuits, especially for heating and EV charging.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Koma á ferli fyrir breytingar á álagi. Endurskoða álag aðaltækjakassa og lykilrása, sérstaklega fyrir hita og hleðslu rafbíla.

risk_templates.title: Ingress of moisture or dust into equipment
risk_templates.description: Enclosures installed in harsher environments than intended; IP rating insufficient for actual conditions.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Select enclosures with appropriate IP rating for the zone. Inspect periodically for signs of condensation, corrosion or contamination. Add heaters or filters where needed.
risk_templates.title_en: Ingress of moisture or dust into equipment
risk_templates.title_is: Innrennsli raka eða ryks í búnað
risk_templates.description_en: Enclosures installed in harsher environments than intended; IP rating insufficient for actual conditions.
risk_templates.description_is: Kassar settir upp í erfiðara umhverfi en ætlað var; IP-stig nægir ekki raunverulegum aðstæðum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Select enclosures with appropriate IP rating for the zone. Inspect periodically for signs of condensation, corrosion or contamination. Add heaters or filters where needed.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Velja kassa með viðeigandi IP-stigi fyrir svæðið. Skoða reglulega leit að raka, tæringu eða mengun. Bæta við hitum eða síum þar sem við á.

risk_templates.title: Main breaker rating not coordinated with upstream protection
risk_templates.description: Main incoming breaker rating or characteristic not coordinated with upstream device (DSO breaker or feeder), leading to poor selectivity or nuisance tripping.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Check selectivity and cascading tables between upstream devices. Coordinate trip curves and ratings so that faults clear at the correct level without unnecessary loss of supply.
risk_templates.title_en: Main breaker rating not coordinated with upstream protection
risk_templates.title_is: Aðalrofi samræmdur ekki við vernd á undan
risk_templates.description_en: Main incoming breaker rating or characteristic not coordinated with upstream device (DSO breaker or feeder), leading to poor selectivity or nuisance tripping.
risk_templates.description_is: Stærð eða einkenni aðalinntaksrofa stemma ekki við tæki á undan (rofi dreifiveitu eða fæðingu), sem getur valdið slæmri valkvæmni eða óþægilegri rofun.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Check selectivity and cascading tables between upstream devices. Coordinate trip curves and ratings so that faults clear at the correct level without unnecessary loss of supply.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Athuga valkvæmi og keðjutöflur milli tækja. Samræma rofakúrfa og stærðir svo bilun hreinsist á réttu stigi án óþarfs taps á rafmagni.

risk_templates.title: Loose terminations at busbars or main lugs
risk_templates.description: Insufficiently tightened or incorrectly assembled main connections causing local heating and potential arcing.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Torque tighten main terminations to manufacturer values using calibrated tools. Consider thermographic inspection during commissioning and early operation.
risk_templates.title_en: Loose terminations at busbars or main lugs
risk_templates.title_is: Slakir tengipunktar á safnastrengjum eða aðaltengingum
risk_templates.description_en: Insufficiently tightened or incorrectly assembled main connections causing local heating and potential arcing.
risk_templates.description_is: Aðaltengingar ekki nægilega aðþrengdar eða rangt settar saman, með hættu á staðbundinni hitun og bogi.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Torque tighten main terminations to manufacturer values using calibrated tools. Consider thermographic inspection during commissioning and early operation.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Þrýsta aðaltengingar samkvæmt verksmiðjuviðmiðum með kviknum verkfærum. Íhuga hitamyndatöku við ræsingu og snemma í rekstri.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate segregation between functional units
risk_templates.description: Switchgear compartments not properly segregated, increasing risk of fault propagation or unsafe access.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Specify form of separation in design (e.g., Form 2/3/4) and verify against the assembly manufacturer’s type-tested arrangement. Ensure doors and barriers are correctly installed.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate segregation between functional units
risk_templates.description_en: Switchgear compartments not properly segregated, increasing risk of fault propagation or unsafe access.
risk_templates.description_is: Rýmum í rofkerfi er ekki skipt rétt, sem eykur hættu á útbreiðslu bilana eða óöruggum aðgangi.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Specify form of separation in design (e.g., Form 2/3/4) and verify against the assembly manufacturer’s type-tested arrangement. Ensure doors and barriers are correctly installed.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Tilgreina aðskilnaðarform í hönnun (t.d. Form 2/3/4) og staðfesta við prófaða uppsetningu framleiðanda. Tryggja að hurðir og hindranir séu rétt settar upp.

risk_templates.title: Emergency lighting not fed from appropriate circuit
risk_templates.description: Emergency luminaires supplied from circuits that may not be energized when required during an outage.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Design emergency lighting supplies in accordance with applicable codes. Verify circuit selection, autonomy and test scheduling.
risk_templates.title_en: Emergency lighting not fed from appropriate circuit
risk_templates.description_en: Emergency luminaires supplied from circuits that may not be energized when required during an outage.
risk_templates.description_is: Neyðarljósgjafar fæddir af rásum sem gætu ekki verið spenntar þegar þarf á þeim að halda við truflun.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Design emergency lighting supplies in accordance with applicable codes. Verify circuit selection, autonomy and test scheduling.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Hanna fæðingu neyðarljóss samkvæmt gildandi kröfum. Staðfesta val rásar, sjálfstæði og prófunaráætlun.

risk_templates.title: Control failure leaves escape routes unlit
risk_templates.description: Automatic lighting control (e.g. occupancy sensors) may inadvertently switch off lighting needed for safe egress.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Configure control strategy so that escape routes and stairways maintain minimum illumination. Verify behaviour during functional testing and commissioning.
risk_templates.title_en: Control failure leaves escape routes unlit
risk_templates.description_en: Automatic lighting control (e.g. occupancy sensors) may inadvertently switch off lighting needed for safe egress.
risk_templates.description_is: Sjálfvirk lýsing (t.d. nærverunemar) getur óviljandi slökkt á lýsingu sem þarf fyrir örugga brottför.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Configure control strategy so that escape routes and stairways maintain minimum illumination. Verify behaviour during functional testing and commissioning.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Stillta stýringu þannig að flóttaleiðir og stigar haldi lágmarks lýsingu. Staðfesta hegðun við virkni- og ræsiprófanir.

risk_templates.title: Incorrect interlocks between fire system and power systems
risk_templates.description: Fire alarm outputs not correctly interfaced to HVAC, smoke control or power shutdown circuits.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Coordinate cause-and-effect matrix with fire designer and M&E. Test all interlocks during integrated system testing and document results.
risk_templates.title_en: Incorrect interlocks between fire system and power systems
risk_templates.title_is: Röng tenging milli brunakerfis og rafmagnskerfa
risk_templates.description_en: Fire alarm outputs not correctly interfaced to HVAC, smoke control or power shutdown circuits.
risk_templates.description_is: Úttök brunavörn eru ekki rétt tengd við loftræstingu, reykkapell eða rofun rafmagns.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Coordinate cause-and-effect matrix with fire designer and M&E. Test all interlocks during integrated system testing and document results.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Samræma orsök- og afleiðingartöflu við brunahönnuð og LVS. Prófa allar tengingar við heildarprófanir og skrá niðurstöður.

risk_templates.title: Non fire-rated cables on critical fire alarm circuits
risk_templates.description: Cabling for critical fire detection/evacuation circuits not selected or routed for required fire survival time.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Specify fire-resistant cables and supports where required by local code. Verify routing avoids unprotected areas where possible.
risk_templates.title_en: Non fire-rated cables on critical fire alarm circuits
risk_templates.title_is: Ekki eldtraustir kaplar á mikilvægum brunaviðvörunarrásum
risk_templates.description_en: Cabling for critical fire detection/evacuation circuits not selected or routed for required fire survival time.
risk_templates.description_is: Kaplar fyrir mikilvæga brunagreiningu/brunaviðvörun eru ekki valdir eða lagðir fyrir krafist eldþols.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Specify fire-resistant cables and supports where required by local code. Verify routing avoids unprotected areas where possible.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Tilgreina eldþola kapla og stuðning þar sem krafist er. Staðfesta leiðir og forðast óvarða svæði eins og unnt er.

risk_templates.title: Electromagnetic interference to control or data cabling
risk_templates.description: Power and data cables run together without segregation, leading to interference on sensitive circuits.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Provide adequate separation or shielding between power and data cables according to manufacturer and standard recommendations. Avoid running parallel for long distances where possible.
risk_templates.title_en: Electromagnetic interference to control or data cabling
risk_templates.description_en: Power and data cables run together without segregation, leading to interference on sensitive circuits.
risk_templates.description_is: Afl- og gagnakaplar lagðir saman án aðskilnaðar, sem getur valdið truflun á viðkvæmum rásum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Provide adequate separation or shielding between power and data cables according to manufacturer and standard recommendations. Avoid running parallel for long distances where possible.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Tryggja nægjanlegan fjarlægð eða skermingu samkvæmt framleiðanda og stöðlum. Forðast langar samsíða legur þar sem unnt er.

risk_templates.title: Single point of failure in communication backbone
risk_templates.description: Critical control or monitoring relies on a single communication path without redundancy.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Consider dual-path or ring topologies for critical systems (BMS, security, fire). Document architecture and test failover behaviour.
risk_templates.title_en: Single point of failure in communication backbone
risk_templates.description_en: Critical control or monitoring relies on a single communication path without redundancy.
risk_templates.description_is: Mikilvæm stýring eða eftirlit byggist á einni samskiptaleið án afritunar.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Consider dual-path or ring topologies for critical systems (BMS, security, fire). Document architecture and test failover behaviour.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Íhuga tvíleið eða hringlög fyrir mikilvæg kerfi (BMS, öryggi, brunavörn). Skrá uppbyggingu og prófa við bilun.

risk_templates.title: Insufficient capacity for EV charging load
risk_templates.description: Main incomer or distribution not sized to handle added EV charger load during peak conditions.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Perform load study including diversity and EV charging scenarios. Provide load management, demand response or panel upgrades where needed.
risk_templates.title_en: Insufficient capacity for EV charging load
risk_templates.description_en: Main incomer or distribution not sized to handle added EV charger load during peak conditions.
risk_templates.description_is: Aðalinntak eða dreifing er ekki metin fyrir viðbótarálag hleðslustöðva við álagstopp.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Perform load study including diversity and EV charging scenarios. Provide load management, demand response or panel upgrades where needed.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Framkvæma álagsrannsókn með fjölbreytni og hleðslu atburðum. Veita álagsstýringu eða uppfæra tækjakassa eftir því sem við á.

risk_templates.title: Incorrect residual current protection for EV chargers
risk_templates.description: RCD type not suitable for chargers that can generate DC residual currents, risking loss of protection.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Follow EV charger manufacturer instructions for RCD type and rating. Use Type A with RDC-DD or Type B devices where required by standards.
risk_templates.title_en: Incorrect residual current protection for EV chargers
risk_templates.description_en: RCD type not suitable for chargers that can generate DC residual currents, risking loss of protection.
risk_templates.description_is: Tegund lekastraumsrofa hentar ekki hleðslustöðvum sem geta myndað DC-lekastraum, með hættu á tapi verndar.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Follow EV charger manufacturer instructions for RCD type and rating. Use Type A with RDC-DD or Type B devices where required by standards.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Fylgja leiðbeiningum framleiðanda hleðslustöðvar um RCD-tegund og stærð. Nota Type A með RDC-DD eða Type B þar sem krafist er.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate protection on temporary site supplies
risk_templates.description: Temporary power boards not equipped with appropriate RCDs and overcurrent protection for site conditions.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Use site distribution boards designed for construction environments with appropriate IP rating and protection. Inspect regularly and test RCDs.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate protection on temporary site supplies
risk_templates.description_en: Temporary power boards not equipped with appropriate RCDs and overcurrent protection for site conditions.
risk_templates.description_is: Tímabundnir aflkassar án viðeigandi lekastraumsrofa og yfirstraumsverndar fyrir verkstaðarskilyrði.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Use site distribution boards designed for construction environments with appropriate IP rating and protection. Inspect regularly and test RCDs.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Nota dreifitæki hönnuð fyrir byggingarumhverfi með viðeigandi IP og vernd. Skoða reglulega og prófa RCD.

risk_templates.title: Trip hazards from temporary cabling
risk_templates.description: Cables laid across walkways or poorly routed, leading to trips and mechanical damage.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Route temporary cables overhead or in protected channels where possible. Use cable covers across walkways and mark routes clearly.
risk_templates.title_en: Trip hazards from temporary cabling
risk_templates.title_is: Hætta á falli vegna tímabundinna kapla
risk_templates.description_en: Cables laid across walkways or poorly routed, leading to trips and mechanical damage.
risk_templates.description_is: Kaplar lagðir yfir gönguleiðir eða illa lagðir, sem veldur fallhættu og vélfraðlegum skemmdum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Route temporary cables overhead or in protected channels where possible. Use cable covers across walkways and mark routes clearly.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Leggja tímabundna kapla uppi eða í vernduðum rásum. Nota kaplahulstur yfir gönguleiðum og merkja leiðir skýrt.

risk_templates.title: UV degradation of exposed cables
risk_templates.description: Cables not UV-resistant installed on roofs or façades, leading to sheath cracking over time.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Specify UV-resistant cables or protective covers for external runs. Periodically inspect exposed cabling.
risk_templates.title_en: UV degradation of exposed cables
risk_templates.description_en: Cables not UV-resistant installed on roofs or façades, leading to sheath cracking over time.
risk_templates.description_is: Kaplar án útivistarþols lagðir á þök eða fasöður, sem getur valdið sprungum í skauti með tímanum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Specify UV-resistant cables or protective covers for external runs. Periodically inspect exposed cabling.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Tilgreina úA-þola kapla eða vernd fyrir útileiðir. Skoða útisetan kapla reglulega.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate fall protection for roof-mounted equipment
risk_templates.description: Technicians accessing roof-mounted panels, PV or HVAC equipment without appropriate fall protection or safe access routes.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Coordinate with structural and H&S teams for safe access (guardrails, anchors, walkways). Include fall protection in risk assessment and method statements.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate fall protection for roof-mounted equipment
risk_templates.title_is: Ófullnægjandi fallvörn við vinnu á þaki
risk_templates.description_en: Technicians accessing roof-mounted panels, PV or HVAC equipment without appropriate fall protection or safe access routes.
risk_templates.description_is: Tæknimenn nálgast búnað á þaki (spenni, PV, LVS) án viðeigandi fallvarnar eða öruggrar aðgangsleiðar.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Coordinate with structural and H&S teams for safe access (guardrails, anchors, walkways). Include fall protection in risk assessment and method statements.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Samræma við burðar- og öryggisstjórnun örugga aðgang ( handrið, föst, göngubrýr). Hafa fallvörn í áhættumati og verkferlum.

risk_templates.title: Incomplete maintenance records for protective devices
risk_templates.description: Lack of documented testing/maintenance history for breakers, RCDs or surge protection devices.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Establish maintenance log with test intervals per manufacturer and local code. Record test results, replacements and settings adjustments.
risk_templates.title_en: Incomplete maintenance records for protective devices
risk_templates.description_en: Lack of documented testing/maintenance history for breakers, RCDs or surge protection devices.
risk_templates.description_is: Skortur á skjalfestri prófun/viðhaldssögu fyrir rofa, lekastraumsrofa eða umspennuvernd.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Establish maintenance log with test intervals per manufacturer and local code. Record test results, replacements and settings adjustments.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Koma á viðhaldsdagbók með prófunartímabilum samkvæmt framleiðanda og staðli. Skrá niðurstöður, skipti og stillingar.

risk_templates.title: Unauthorized modifications to panels or circuits
risk_templates.description: Changes made by unqualified personnel without updating documentation or labels.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Restrict access to switchgear, enforce change control procedures and periodically audit installations against drawings.
risk_templates.title_en: Unauthorized modifications to panels or circuits
risk_templates.title_is: Óheimilar breytingar á tækjakössum eða rásum
risk_templates.description_en: Changes made by unqualified personnel without updating documentation or labels.
risk_templates.description_is: Breytingar gerðar af óhæfum aðilum án uppfærðra skjala eða merkinga.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Restrict access to switchgear, enforce change control procedures and periodically audit installations against drawings.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Takmarka aðgang að rofkerfi, beita breytingastjórnun og endurskoða uppsetningu miðað við teikningar.

risk_templates.title: Lightning protection not bonded to main earthing system
risk_templates.description: Lightning protection system (LPS) earth not coordinated with building main earth, causing dangerous potential differences.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Coordinate LPS and power earthing design per applicable lightning protection standards. Ensure bonding and test continuity.
risk_templates.title_en: Lightning protection not bonded to main earthing system
risk_templates.description_en: Lightning protection system (LPS) earth not coordinated with building main earth, causing dangerous potential differences.
risk_templates.description_is: Jarðun þrumuvörn er ekki samræmd við aðaljarðun byggingar, sem getur valdið hættulegum spennuummun.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Coordinate LPS and power earthing design per applicable lightning protection standards. Ensure bonding and test continuity.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Samræma hönnun þrumuvörn og afljarðunar samkvæmt viðeigandi þrumuvörnustöðlum. Tryggja jafnspennutengingu og prófa samfelldni.

risk_templates.title: High earth resistance at remote structures
risk_templates.description: Auxiliary structures or remote equipment with insufficient earthing resistance for protective device operation.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Measure earth resistance at remote points and upgrade earthing (additional rods, tapes, meshes) where needed. Verify disconnection times with protective devices.
risk_templates.title_en: High earth resistance at remote structures
risk_templates.description_en: Auxiliary structures or remote equipment with insufficient earthing resistance for protective device operation.
risk_templates.description_is: Aukabyggingar eða fjarlægur búnaður með ónægjanlegu jarðunarviðnámi fyrir virkni verndartækja.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Measure earth resistance at remote points and upgrade earthing (additional rods, tapes, meshes) where needed. Verify disconnection times with protective devices.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Mæla jarðunarviðnám á fjarlægum stöðum og bæta jarðun (viðbótarsúlur, borð, net) eftir því sem við á. Staðfesta aftengingartíma með verndartækjum.

risk_templates.title: Unsafe default states on control system failure
risk_templates.description: Loss of control power or PLC failure leaves equipment in an unsafe or undefined state.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Design fail-safe states for critical actuators and interlocks. Test power-loss and restart behaviour during commissioning.
risk_templates.title_en: Unsafe default states on control system failure
risk_templates.title_is: Óörugg sjálfgefin ástand við bilun stýrikerfis
risk_templates.description_en: Loss of control power or PLC failure leaves equipment in an unsafe or undefined state.
risk_templates.description_is: Tap á stýrirafmagni eða bilun PLC skilur búnað eftir í óöruggu eða óskilgreindu ástandi.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Design fail-safe states for critical actuators and interlocks. Test power-loss and restart behaviour during commissioning.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Hanna örugg sjálfgefin ástand fyrir mikilvægar aðgerðir og lásanir. Prófa hegðun við rafmagnsleysi og endurræsingu við ræsingu.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate segregation of safety-related control circuits
risk_templates.description: Safety functions (e.g., emergency stops) not segregated from standard control circuits, increasing risk of common-cause failure.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Apply functional safety and wiring segregation principles for safety-related parts of control systems. Follow manufacturer guidance and applicable standards.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate segregation of safety-related control circuits
risk_templates.description_en: Safety functions (e.g., emergency stops) not segregated from standard control circuits, increasing risk of common-cause failure.
risk_templates.description_is: Öryggisvirkni (t.d. neyðarstopp) ekki aðskilin frá venjulegum stýringarrásum, sem eykur hættu á sameiginlegum bilanagáttum.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Apply functional safety and wiring segregation principles for safety-related parts of control systems. Follow manufacturer guidance and applicable standards.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Beita aðilöryggi og kaplaðskilnaði fyrir öryggisrásir. Fylgja leiðbeiningum framleiðanda og viðeigendum stöðlum.

risk_templates.title: Obstructed access to switchgear and panels
risk_templates.description: Storage or furniture blocking access to distribution boards, preventing safe operation and maintenance.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Specify and mark minimum working space in front of panels. Communicate requirements to client and verify during inspections.
risk_templates.title_en: Obstructed access to switchgear and panels
risk_templates.title_is: Hindraður aðgangur að rofkerfi og tækjakössum
risk_templates.description_en: Storage or furniture blocking access to distribution boards, preventing safe operation and maintenance.
risk_templates.description_is: Geymsla eða húsgögn hindra aðgang að dreifitækjum, sem torveldar örugga rekstur og viðhald.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Specify and mark minimum working space in front of panels. Communicate requirements to client and verify during inspections.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Tilgreina og merkja lágmarks vinnusvæði fyrir framan tækjakassa. Koma kröfum til viðskiptavinar og staðfesta við eftirlit.

risk_templates.title: Inadequate lighting at electrical equipment
risk_templates.description: Poor lighting around panels or plant, increasing risk of errors during switching or maintenance.
risk_templates.default_mitigation: Provide adequate fixed lighting at all main panels and control locations. Verify lux levels during commissioning.
risk_templates.title_en: Inadequate lighting at electrical equipment
risk_templates.description_en: Poor lighting around panels or plant, increasing risk of errors during switching or maintenance.
risk_templates.description_is: Slæm lýsing við tækjakassa eða vélbúnað, sem eykur hættu á villum við rofun eða viðhald.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_en: Provide adequate fixed lighting at all main panels and control locations. Verify lux levels during commissioning.
risk_templates.default_mitigation_is: Veita nægjanlega föst lýsingu við öll aðaltækjakassa og stýristöðvar. Staðfesta ljósmagn við ræsingu.
